# gws CLI: Google Classroom reference

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the full Google Classroom API v1 reference for the `gws` CLI: courses, invitations, registrations and userProfiles/guardians, with the real permission constraints documented. The first Classroom fiche in the catalog — no equivalent in lots 31-33. Its task companion `googleworkspace-cli-recipe-create-classroom-course` is listed separately in this lot (reference vs recipe pattern, same as lot 33's `gws-calendar` / `gws-calendar-insert`). By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free; Classroom generally requires a paid Google Workspace for Education account); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
